methodology.unit: effective blended price (¥/M tokens, coding-agent token mix)
methodology.token_mix: OpenCode-observed agent mix (fresh input / cache / output); subscription uses vendor quota
methodology.deepseek_api: 24h time-weighted peak/off-peak average (7h peak + 17h off-peak CST)
methodology.opencode_go: subscription amortization; DeepSeek plans ×1.5 for unmodeled peak/off-peak
methodology.commandcode_goat: subscription amortization; DeepSeek plans ×1.5 for unmodeled peak/off-peak
methodology.codex_plus: 5h rolling window max msgs × (168h/5h windows per week) × weeks/month; additional weekly caps per OpenAI docs are not public
methodology.minimax_token_plan: individual monthly Plus ¥49 / Max ¥119 / Ultra ¥469 amortized over official M3 token pool; M3 and M2.7 share quota
methodology.mimo_token_plan: individual monthly Lite/Standard/Pro/Max CNY amortized over Credit quota; Credits/token differ by model and cache/output, converted with agent mix; night 0.8x and promo discounts excluded
methodology.match_strategy: vendor plan model slugs/labels matched to live ranked model ids
methodology.excluded_plans: Zhipu GLM Coding Plan; Kimi membership/API official plans (not comparable on this leaderboard)
